In Modern Mandarin, 占 and 站 are both read zhàn. This present-day match alone does not establish their historical sound relation.

Lexicographic analyses assign 占 a phonetic role in 站. Their shared Modern Mandarin reading, zhàn, and a reported Zhengzhang Old Chinese comparison are relevant, but do not independently confirm that historical role. The Baxter–Sagart table lists 占 but has no 站 entry for comparison.
